title: Transports
excerpt: Transports MCP uses a [transport layer] to handle the communication between clients and servers. Three transport mechanisms are supported: stdio , Streamable HTTP , and SSE (Server Sent Events, legacy). [transport layer]: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025 11 25/basic/transports stdio transport The stdio transport communicates over standard input and output streams.
